draft.text: You came in because you have had a cough for three days.
Your cough started after being around a sick sister.
You also have green phlegm, a sore throat, and a stuffy nose.
We did not do any tests or check your body during this visit.
Your symptoms may be from a respiratory infection.
The doctor will order a chest X-ray and a sputum culture to learn more.
You should keep taking your medicines for diabetes and blood pressure.
You will need to come back in 2 to 3 days for another checkup.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have had a cough for three days.
Your cough started after being around a sick sister.
You have a cough with green phlegm, a sore throat, and a stuffy nose.
You do not have a fever, chest pain, or trouble breathing.
These symptoms may be from a respiratory infection.
This is a common illness that affects the lungs and airways.
The doctor will order a chest X-ray and a test of your phlegm to learn more.
You should keep taking your diabetes and blood pressure medicines as usual.
You will need to come back in 2 to 3 days for another checkup.
